Architectural ironmongery for restoration work

Ironbark Supply is an architectural ironmongery merchant supplying hand-forged hinges, latches and fixings to restoration builders across the UK. We have been forging to conservation-officer specification since 1994.

Browse the ironmongery range

What we stock

We hold 340 lines in blacksmith-forged iron, cast bronze and gunmetal, with lead times of 5 to 15 working days on made-to-order pieces.

Who we supply

Our customers are restoration contractors, heritage joiners and conservation architects working on listed buildings. We are not a general builders' merchant.

Where we are

The forge and trade counter are at Weir Lane, Ludlow, SY8 1PL. Call +44 1584 872 300.
